text:
ryan: SLO alert - ap-south proxy mtls success rate fell to ~85% in 10m window. Seeing a spike in cert unwrap errors. Anyone touching KMS or keystore rotation yesterday?

ops-bot: ALERT: mtls.success_rate_drop service=proxy-ap-south window=10m value=85% runbook=eng-security/mtls-triage

jess: I did a housekeeping pass yesterday and ran an automated key rotation job for the ephemeral keystore. I also modified audit sampling to reduce noise (100% -> 5%) as we were hitting log quotas. Patch ref: infra/audit-2026-03-20-rotate.

maya: Can you paste the failing log lines?

ryan: Snippet from proxy-ingress: 
```
2026-03-22T01:11:02Z proxy-ap-south auth=mtls handshake_ok=false err="kms.KeyNotFound" key=projects/redwood/locations/asia-south1/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-rot
2026-03-22T01:11:03Z proxy-ap-south auth=mtls handshake_ok=false err="certstore.unable_to_unwrap" subject=service-b.redwood.internal
```

sam: KeyNotFound suggests the rotation job created a new key version but the IAM binding for the proxy-keystore SA wasn't copied to the new version or key name changed. If sampling dropped to 5% we probably missed the early firing alerts.

jess: Ugh, the rotation job uses `gcloud kms keys versions create` and then promotes the new version but I did not include a step to copy IAM from previous version. I thought IAM was on key ring. Looks like our job created a new key resource with a slightly different name (typo). Patch id infra/2026-03-20-rotate.

maya: Compliance note: sampling drop means we can't produce complete handshake logs for the window. Need an estimated count of lost events and heads-up to legal if any regulated customers hit >1% loss.

compliance-bot: POLICY: if log coverage for mtls falls below 99% for >5m affecting regulated customers, notify security-lead and legal.

sam: Quick mitigation: (A) fix IAM by adding decrypt role to existing SA for the new key, or (B) roll proxy-keystore back to previous static bundle (fallback-keystore) while we patch rotation. Option A is lower-ops but touches KMS policy.

jess: I'll run the targeted IAM fix with a canary:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/asia-south1/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-rot \
  --member="serviceAccount:proxy-keystore@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```

jess: Applying to one key region canary first.

ops-bot: NOTE: audit-sampling-change recorded user=jess before=100% after=5% time=2026-03-20T04:02:00Z id=infra/audit-2026-03-20-rotate

(3m)

jess: Canary looks good — can confirm unwraps now succeed and handshake_ok=true. Rolling to rest of ap-south nodes.

ryan: Observability shows recovery to ~98% post-rollout. We'll keep SLO open for 30m to ensure stability.

maya: I'll open INC-2026-042 and add timeline: rotation job (typo created new key), IAM missing on new key, sampling lowered to 5% which masked the issue, mitigation: IAM add and restore sampling to 100%. Estimated lost handshakes: ~14k over 10m window (ballpark).

sam: Follow-ups: 1) Update rotation job to copy IAM from previous key and include a preflight IAM check; 2) Add unit test that verifies new key has required members; 3) Dont drop sampling below 50% without a runbook.

jess: I'll open a PR for the rotation job changes and the preflight script that runs `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and compares expected principals before promoting a new key.

ryan: Also let's add an SLO correlation alert: if mtls_handshake_rate drops + kms.unwrap_errors increase -> auto-annotate incident to KMS/IAM.

compliance-bot: Reminder: document retained events and attach to INC-2026-042 for audit.

maya: Thanks team. Leaving incident assigned to jess/sam/ryan for remediation and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
